name: API Usage Overview
description: Organization and environment API usage across Novu regions. Filter by org ID, compare regional traffic, and detect endpoint spikes.

pages.name: Overview
pages.description: Regional API traffic and top organizations

rawConfiguration.text:
# API Usage Overview

Use the filters above to narrow by **deployment region** (US/EU/UK/...), **organization ID**, or **Novu environment ID**.

- **Region** = where the API runs (`[PROD-US] - API`, `[PROD-EU] - API`, ...)
- **Environment ID** = Novu workspace environment within an org (dev/prod)
- Data comes from APM `Transaction` events with `organizationId` / `environmentId` custom attributes

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', uniqueCount(organizationId) AS 'Organizations', uniqueCount(environmentId) AS 'Novu envs' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}')

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %', filter(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Errors' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}')

SELECT average(duration) AS 'Avg ms', percentile(duration, 95) AS 'P95 ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}')

SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET appName TIMESERIES 1 hour

SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET appName LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', uniqueCount(name) AS 'Endpoints', uniqueCount(environmentId) AS 'Novu envs', average(duration) AS 'Avg ms', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET organizationId, appName LIMIT 50

pages.name: By organization
pages.description: Endpoint breakdown for a selected org and Novu environment

rawConfiguration.text:
## Organization drill-down

Set **Organization ID** in the filter bar to inspect a single customer. Leave blank to see the top orgs across all regions.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET appName TIMESERIES 1 hour

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', average(duration) AS 'Avg ms', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET organizationId, environmentId, appName LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', average(duration) AS 'Avg ms', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET name LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', average(duration) AS 'Avg ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND name LIKE '%events/trigger%' AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET organizationId, environmentId, appName, name LIMIT 50

pages.name: Spikes
pages.description: Detect org/endpoint traffic spikes vs the previous period

rawConfiguration.text:
## Spike detection

Tables compare **last hour vs same hour yesterday**. Line charts compare **today vs one week ago**. Look for orgs with large positive deltas on specific endpoints.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET organizationId, appName, name SINCE 1 hour ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '[PROD-%] - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND name LIKE '%events/trigger%' AND ({{region}} = 'All' OR appName = '{{region}}') AND ('{{environmentId}}' = '' OR environmentId = '{{environmentId}}') AND ('{{organizationId}}' = '' OR organizationId = '{{organizationId}}') FACET organizationId, environmentId, appName, name SINCE 1 hour ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago LIMIT 50
